intent_snapshot.goal: J1: a scripted single-task drive reaches a terminal TaskRecord with audit and delivered commit on Claude Code and Pi (Spec D2, J1) (Initiative e2e-release-gate slice S4; Spec docs/specs/e2e-release-gate.spec.md).

acceptance.assertion: bun run e2e single-task drives one scripted task from enrollment through Executor launch, implementation, QA and Review to a terminal TaskRecord with an audit directory and a delivered commit, for the claude and pi Executors. Negative cases: an Executor launch lacking --plugin-dir and an entry that is not the /immune-brain:drive slash command each fail the journey with a named assertion. Done looks like: tests/e2e/single-task.e2e.ts passes with both negatives asserted. Prerequisite: the pinned claude binary from tests/e2e/hosts.json is installed on the QA host (maintainer machine provides claude 2.1.330); an absent binary fails the check rather than skipping.

acceptance_results.summary: host-attested QA: all 2 project verification check(s) passed; execution=sha256:8e1191d86bf854b764ca871cdd45c37bdce61b9f5829041ef7a11b1d58985fce

attestations.summary: single-task.e2e.ts drives claude and pi Executor journeys to a done TaskRecord, audit dir and imm(hello-task) commit, with named entry_not_drive_command and executor_plugin_dir_missing assertions; blast radius tier low, load-bearing paths tests/e2e/harness/mock-model.ts and the shared tests/fixtures/fake-herdr/herdr fixture

advisory_findings.summary: In-journey assertDriveEntry checks the harness's own literal entry (parentCommand -p arg) rather than the entry the Parent observed; the negatives are exercised only as helper unit tests, never as a journey run with a bad entry

evidence.trigger: runJourney(executor, entry) is never called with a non-drive entry; assertDriveEntry(run.parentCommand[...]) re-validates the default '/immune-brain:drive hello-task' string the harness itself wrote, so a regression in how the entry reaches the Parent (e.g. mock-model main conversation first user text) would not be caught by this assertion

advisory_findings.summary: Claude Executor launch is selected as the first claude launch carrying --model, which would also match the claude Reviewer launch if ordering changed

evidence.trigger: launches.jsonl where the Review session's claude launch is appended before the Executor's → assertExecutorPluginDir validates the Reviewer's args and the Executor's --plugin-dir goes unchecked

advisory_findings.summary: fake-herdr now passes FAKE_HERDR_STATE to every spawned Host and host-shim requires python3 for the Pi pty; both are unstated harness prerequisites shared with unit tests using the fixture

evidence.trigger: a unit test using tests/fixtures/fake-herdr/herdr with spawn:true now has its child processes inherit FAKE_HERDR_STATE (previously filtered), and a QA host without python3 → Pi Executor journey fails with a pty spawn error rather than a named host_binary_missing
